subject: Last-minute illness — proposed split format & async option for today's interview
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@example.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interview confirmation — 11/30 (virtual) — Samuel Ortiz

Hi team / Samuel —

Confirming tomorrow's virtual interview loop for Samuel (Senior Software Engineer):
- 10:00–10:30 PST: System design (Hannah) — Meet link in calendar
- 11:00–11:45 PST: Pairing & coding (Lauren) — collaborative pad + pairing link
- 12:00–12:30 PST: Manager chat (Markus) — short sync

Candidate materials attached: takehome_challenge.pdf (optional, we asked Sam to have it handy for the pairing exercise). Calendar invite has the Meet links; please flag if you need to swap or drop in.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad | Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 06:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — 11/30 (virtual) — Samuel Ortiz

Hi Mina and team —

I hate to do this last minute but I woke up with a fever (about 101°F) and feel pretty rough. I don't want to waste anyone's time on pair programming or be unfocused for a manager conversation. If possible I'd prefer to reschedule the full loop to next week.

If rescheduling for next week is difficult, I'm open to alternatives:
- I could do a short 20–30 min phone screen today in the afternoon if that helps keep things moving, or
- I can complete the take-home coding exercise (attached in the earlier thread) and share it by EOD tomorrow so you can review asynchronously.

Sorry again for the curveball and thanks for understanding — I can be available Tue/Wed next week (PST) between 09:30–14:00.

Best,
Sam Ortiz
samuel.ortiz@example.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — 11/30 (virtual) — Samuel Ortiz

Thanks for flagging, Sam — totally sympathetic, rest up.

Team, quick suggestions to keep momentum without forcing an in-person-style pairing while Sam recovers:
1) Offer the take-home option: Mina — can we send the Drive link and ask Sam if he'd like to submit the take-home by EOD tomorrow? If so, Lauren could review asynchronously and give a short write-up.
2) Move the manager + behavioral conversation to next week (Markus/Hannah) as a 30-min sync.
3) If Sam feels up to a short touchpoint today, I'm available at 11:00–11:30 PST to do a light phone screen focussed on high-level design and fit (no whiteboard). I'll keep it optional and recorded notes only.

If we go with the take-home route, I can volunteer to do a quick pass on the submission and leave detailed feedback for the panel. Please let me know availability and whether we should block a follow-up debrief slot in Greenhouse.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Staff SWE (Hiring loop) | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — 11/30 (virtual) — Samuel Ortiz

Agree with Dylan — candidate health first. Mina, please mark the current loop as "pending — candidate reschedule" in Greenhouse and propose two windows for next week. If Sam prefers the take-home, let's treat Lauren's review as sufficient initial evaluation; we can follow up with a manager chat only after we see the submission.

I'll defer to Lauren on whether she's comfortable evaluating a take-home asynchronously; if not, we can move the pairing to next week. Also, if we decide to keep any phone touchpoint today I can join briefly if it's helpful.

Thanks all — Markus

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@example.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — 11/30 (virtual) — Samuel Ortiz

Sam — thanks for the quick update. Rest is the right call. I've updated the Greenhouse stage to "pending — candidate reschedule" (link: https://greenhouse.example.com/12345) and proposed two windows in the calendar for Tue/Wed next week (see attached .ics).

Options we've offered Sam:
- Submit the take-home by EOD tomorrow and have Lauren review asynchronously (we'll collect notes and decide if we still need live pairing), or
- Reschedule the full loop for Tue or Wed next week (Sam suggested 09:30–14:00 PST).

Sam has chosen to rest and reschedule — he asked us to propose Tue 12/1 11:00–12:30 PST first; I've tentatively held that slot and sent an updated invite (proposed-reschedule-invite.ics). If anyone cannot make that new time, please reply-all with alternatives.

Attachments: takehome_challenge.pdf (copy of the exercise) and proposed-reschedule-invite.ics

Thanks everyone for the quick flexibility. I'll follow up if Sam changes his mind about doing the take-home instead.

— Mina
Mina Haddad | Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
